source: at DEBUG, 8.0.0's `matcher{}would match{}if matcher was used for control plane` from a conditional expectation's branches (in the scan only; each request differs from the conditional in one field, so the closest-match hint is deterministic), from a -bin header (values without base64 padding), and never from an OpenAPI expectation (its operation matchers are control-plane matchers, so the reversed regex matches); an invalid regex logs no `error while matching regex` entry (NottableString.matches swallows the PatternSyntaxException).

the if branch's header value, read as a regex, would match; the else branch matches (no hint)
